caseStudies.title: Transforming Direct Bookings for a Boutique Restaurant
caseStudies.seoTitle: La Ferme Medina Case Study | Ayoub Erradi
caseStudies.seoDescription: Discover how we helped La Ferme Medina increase direct reservations by 120% with a custom website and local SEO strategy.
caseStudies.overview: La Ferme Medina is a premier dining destination in the heart of Marrakech. They needed a digital presence that reflected their unique ambiance while driving more direct table reservations.
caseStudies.challenge: The restaurant relied heavily on third-party booking platforms, which ate into their profit margins. Their existing website was outdated, not mobile-friendly, and failed to rank for local searches like "best restaurants in Marrakech Medina".
caseStudies.solution: We completely redesigned their website with a mobile-first approach, integrating a seamless direct booking widget. We implemented a robust local SEO strategy, optimizing their Google Business Profile and targeting high-intent dining keywords.

testimonial.text: The new website completely changed our business. We're fully booked most nights entirely through our own site, saving us thousands in commission fees.
testimonial.author: Management Team

caseStudies.title: Scaling Luxury Hospitality with Digital Excellence
caseStudies.seoTitle: Riad Inn Medina Case Study | Ayoub Erradi
caseStudies.seoDescription: See how Riad Inn Medina boosted international bookings and brand visibility through our custom WordPress and SEO solutions.
caseStudies.overview: Riad Inn Medina offers a luxury Moroccan experience. They sought to elevate their brand to attract high-end international travelers and reduce OTA dependency.
caseStudies.challenge: Despite a stunning physical location, their digital presence was lackluster. They suffered from slow page loads, a confusing booking flow, and poor visibility in key European markets.
caseStudies.solution: We built a high-performance WordPress site featuring immersive photography, a frictionless direct booking engine, and multilingual SEO targeting travelers from France, the UK, and Spain.

testimonial.text: Our international visibility skyrocketed. The seamless booking experience has made it incredibly easy for guests to reserve directly with us.
testimonial.author: Owner

caseStudies.title: Automating Lead Generation for Assafaa Bayt
caseStudies.seoTitle: Real Estate Lead Generation Case Study | Ayoub Erradi
caseStudies.seoDescription: How we transformed a real estate agency's digital presence to generate 200+ qualified buyer leads per month.
caseStudies.overview: Assafaa Bayt Immobilier is a leading real estate agency needing a modern platform to showcase properties and capture high-quality buyer and seller leads.
caseStudies.challenge: Their agents spent too much time fielding calls from unqualified leads. Their website lacked advanced filtering, making it hard for users to find relevant properties.
caseStudies.solution: We developed a custom real estate portal with advanced search filters, map integration, and automated lead capture funnels that qualify prospects before they reach an agent.

testimonial.text: The quality of leads has improved dramatically. Our agents are now spending their time closing deals rather than answering basic questions.
testimonial.author: Sales Director

about_data.heroDescription: Based in Morocco, I combine digital strategy, website development, design, marketing, and content creation into one seamless, results-driven experience. No more juggling multiple freelancers or agencies—just one trusted partner dedicated to your growth.
about_data.storyParagraph1: It started over 10 years ago with a simple website for a local business. What began as a single project evolved into a deep passion for combining technology with creativity.
about_data.storyParagraph2: Along the way, I realized something important: businesses don't need just a website. They need a complete digital ecosystem—one that looks beautiful, works flawlessly, and actually grows their business.
about_data.storyParagraph3: That's why I've spent years mastering digital solutions across website development, graphic design, photography, video production, SEO, and digital marketing. It's why I can look at your business and see the whole picture.
